JSON strings must be valid UTF-8. The source recommends ISO-8859-1 as fromCharset and UTF-8 as toCharset for non-UTF-8 input. For JSON serialization, the to_charset parameter requires utf-8 or US-ASCII; other output encodings have undefined behavior. Conflicting content and output encodings may cause an extra UTF-8 encoding layer.

Omitted fromCharset defaults to _DETECT_, toCharset to _LOCALE_ and updateHtmlDocumentEncoding to 1. Content is returned as a string; no character-set conversion or file-content decoding is performed by the client. The pinned from_charset and to_charset response schemas are empty and remain mixed; do not infer them from the separately typed from_char and to_char fields.

Use the existing scalar encoding for a caller-supplied pre-serialized filter, consistent with the scalar pipe-delimited Ftp filters. Do not send repeated keys or infer an integer filter meaning from the existing string|int scalar boundary.

Optional response row fields remain absent when omitted. dirs and files are separate lists, preserving empty lists. exists, isleaf, isparent, read and write are integer 0|1 flags. size is in bytes; mode is a string and nicemode is an integer.

types is a pre-serialized pipe-separated scalar such as file|dir, following the pinned prose and pipeDelimited style with explode=false. The existing scalar encoding has a string|int native boundary and forwards the caller value without delimiter parsing; this does not establish an integer filter meaning. onlyTheseFiles is a comma-separated string. MIME filters cause the server to set include_mime=1 even when includeMime is false.

The limit_to_list description refers to a filepath- prefix but the pinned operation declares no indexed filepath- parameters or family encoding. Only the declared limitToList flag is exposed; no indexed inputs are inferred. Omitted options retain server defaults and explicit false is sent as 0.
